notes.content:
This update focuses on enhancing the gaming experience by addressing specific technical issues.

[b]Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Collision Issue Resolved: fixed a rare but impactful bug where players could experience infinite collisions under certain conditions. This fix should provide a smoother and more stable gaming experience.
[/list]
[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Removed CPU Check at Startup: removed the minimum CPU requirement check that occurs at game launch. 
[/list]

notes.title: 0.83 build
notes.content:
1. Enhanced Leaderboard Feature: The menu screen now proudly displays the "Hall of Fame", featuring the top 15 players, adding a competitive edge and recognition for top performers.

2. Better Steam Client Integration: Enhanced detection capabilities have been implemented to ensure seamless integration whenever the Steam client becomes available.

3. Debugging Information Update: Debugging data, previously included by default, has been removed from the release version.

4. Expanded Language Support.
